title: Creating & Printing Variables
description: Let's create your first variables! In the editor below, create a variable named name with value "Alice" and a variable named age with value 25. Then print name on the first line and age on the second line.
starter_code:
# Create your variables below:
name = "Alice"
age = 25

# Print the variables (without quotes around variable names):
print(name)
print(age)
